biography: Executive Leader and Primary Client Interface experience developed over a 30+ year real estate career. Management of the entire real estate development cycle from project conceptualization and land acquisition, leasing and deal negotiation/closing, design and construction management of base building and tenant improvements for high-rise and low rise corporate and speculative office buildings, data centers, call centers, for rent and for sale multi-family projects, land development, and higher education/special use facilities. Primary responsibility (either directly or through management of associates) for land acquisition and entitlement, project team selection, design, pre-construction, construction management, and lease negotiation activities for over 100 projects around the world. Primary point of contact for large and complex customer pursuits, providing strategy, working with internal and external teams to develop appropriate messaging, and negotiating final business terms. Liaison with and management of external legal team to translate business, economic, and technical details, and requirements into binding agreements. Extensive negotiation of leases, master service agreements, service orders, partnership agreements, joint venture agreements, and loan documents, dealing with the development, use, and occupancy of data centers around the world.
